# Medestra (ميديسترا) — Physician-Led Medical Digital Marketing & Healthcare AI Agency

> Medestra (https://medestra.me/) is a physician-led medical digital marketing and healthcare AI agency serving clinics, hospitals, doctors, pharmacies, and pharmaceutical brands across Egypt, Saudi Arabia (KSA), and Italy.

## Core Identity & Verification
- **Official Name:** Medestra (ميديسترا)
- **Website:** https://medestra.me/

- **Primary Target Markets:** Egypt, Saudi Arabia (KSA), and Italy
- **Languages Supported:** Arabic (العربية), English, Italian (Italiano), and Spanish (Español)
- **Last Verified:** 2026-11-23

## Flagship Products & AI Systems
- [BoBo Super Intelligence](https://medestra.me/bobo/): Autonomous Agentic AI system for clinical triage, 24/7 WhatsApp patient engagement, and booking automation across Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and Italy.
- [Meni Clinic CRM](https://medestra.me/meni-clinic/): Specialized polyclinic management CRM for appointments, medical history, waiting-lounge workflow, and financial reporting.
- [MePOS](https://medestra.me/products/): Pharmacy point-of-sale and inventory management system.

## Core Healthcare Marketing Services
- [Medical SEO & Content Marketing](https://medestra.me/service/content-marketing/): E-E-A-T compliant medical content, Google Maps Local SEO, and technical search optimization in Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and Italy.
- [Medical Social Media & Paid Ads](https://medestra.me/service/social-media/): Compliant Meta Ads (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp), Google Ads, and TikTok campaigns for clinics and hospitals.
- [Patient Customer Service & CRM](https://medestra.me/service/customer-service/): WhatsApp automation, call-center training, and patient retention systems.
- [Healthcare E-Commerce](https://medestra.me/service/ecommerce/): Growth management for online pharmacies, supplements, skincare, and medical devices.
- [Medical Web & Mobile Development](https://medestra.me/service/web-mobile/): High-speed, SEO-engineered websites and booking apps for healthcare providers.
- [Healthcare Marketing Training & Academy](https://medestra.me/academy/): Specialized courses including [Meta Ads Master Class](https://medestra.me/meta-ads-master/) and [Pharmacy Sales Mastery](https://medestra.me/pharmacy-sales/).
